themes.mechanism: :root holds dark; @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) overrides every token; color-scheme: dark light. colorMeta.<token>.light carries the light value.

bg-2.purpose: Code panels, review notes, the resume button.

bg-band.purpose: HEAD row, hovered rows, inline code.

line-2.purpose: Resume button border, code scrollbar thumb.

fg-2.purpose: Ledes, summaries, review text, back link.

fg-3.purpose: Hashes, nav at rest, meta, line numbers, TOC at rest.

frontend.purpose: The frontend lane, pill, and nodes.

backend.purpose: The backend lane; also focus ring, selection, body links, review head tint.

main.purpose: The trunk, merge nodes, the root commit.

add-ink.purpose: The + mark; 55% into fg for added code text.

syn-title.purpose: hljs title, function_, class_, section, name.

pill-ink.purpose: Light end of the branch-tag text mix.

wordmark.purpose: Lowercase "devgrr" in the top bar; 24px under 960px.

display.purpose: Post h1, balanced; 30px under 960px. Sibling: home preview title 35px/40px.

headline.purpose: Post h2; feeds the TOC. 56px above, 18px below. 22px under 960px.

title.purpose: Commit row titles, one line with ellipsis; post h3 at 600.

lede.purpose: Post opening paragraph in fg-2. Sibling: preview summary 17.5px/24.5px, max 62ch.

body.purpose: Post body, 22px paragraph gap; home base 17px/1.6; 16.5px under 960px.

meta.purpose: Ref line, footer, back link (15.5px), tables (16px).

label.purpose: Lowercase branch pills; 12.5px on the post branch chip.

code.purpose: Code panels; 14px/20px on mobile; filename tab 13px; inline code 0.9em.

hash.purpose: Seven-character FNV-1a hash beside each row title; 15px on the ref line.

shadows.name: floating-control
shadows.purpose: Only under a position: fixed element over content (the resume button). Nothing in flow carries a shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing (--ease) for every transition and keyframe.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Color and background on nav links, TOC links, branch tags, underline color.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Row background on hover/HEAD; node transform.

motion.name: state-slow
motion.purpose: Opacity of lanes, nodes, and rows when a branch filter is pressed.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Lanes draw from the root via stroke-dashoffset (pathLength 1).

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: The preview pane fades in after the log.

motion.name: stagger
motion.value: 0.15s + 0.9s x (distance from root / graph height) + 0.06s x lane index
motion.purpose: Per-row delay (--d); lanes get 0.08s x index; merge arcs +0.12s, merge nodes +0.32s after their row.

motion.name: sequence-end
motion.purpose: The is-drawn class is removed; afterwards only state transitions run.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No keyframes at all; layout runs once fonts are ready; resume scroll is instant.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: pills and rows shift 96px; pill gap 4px; resume button inset 14px.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: one column, preview removed, row summaries shown, lanes packed at an 18px gap, top bar 64px.

breakpoints.name: home-zoom
breakpoints.purpose: At or above: .home zoom clamp(0.93, 100vw / 1376px, 1.16); the comp rhythm holds from 1280 to 1600.

breakpoints.name: toc
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: TOC rail hidden; post is a single 70ch column.

narrative.overview:
devgrr is one senior developer's log for juniors, and the site draws itself the way that log looks in a terminal. The home page is `git log --graph`: a main trunk on the far left, four topic lanes forking from the root commit and merging back into it, a title and a hash on every row. The right pane is the checked-out post, HEAD. Every post opens with its ref line: branch chip, hash, date. The scene is a developer's editor at night; dark is the default written in `:root`, and light is a full sibling theme rather than a fallback.

Density is editorial, not dashboard: a 100px row pitch on the log, a 70ch measure on posts, 56px section breaks. Decoration comes only from things git and an editor already print: lanes, nodes, hashes, diff gutters, a filename tab, a review comment. There are no cards, no gradients, no thumbnails, no icon set (one inline chevron), and no shadow on anything in flow.

Where the direction contract and the build diverged, this file records the build. The ground shipped as #12151b rather than the contract's #0e1218, the home split is two equal columns rather than one-third and two-thirds, and the graph topology became a main trunk with merge arcs by the user's decision during the hero phase.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with a full light sibling; every color token exists in both blocks.
Two typefaces with strict jobs: Wanted Sans for prose, Commit Mono for anything git would print.
Five branch colors reach elements through one custom property, `--c`, set by `data-branch`.
Flat tonal layering with 1px hairlines; one shadow exists, under a fixed button.
One authored motion, the log rising from its root; everything else is a 0.2 to 0.3s state change.
A radius ladder of 4, 5, 8, 10px and pill.

rules.name: The One Lane Rule
rules.body: A branch color reaches an element only through `--c`, which `[data-branch]` sets from the five branch variables. No rule names a branch hex directly; a new branch-colored element gets `data-branch`, not a color.

rules.name: The Sibling Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color token is declared twice: in `:root` for dark and in the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block. A color that exists in one block only is a bug.

rules.name: The Blue Has Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Backend blue is the only branch color that also works as the interaction color: focus ring, selection tint, body links, and the review-note head tint. The other four never leave their lane.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Wanted Sans for what a person wrote; Commit Mono, ligatures off, for what git or the editor prints: the wordmark, hashes, filenames, code. There is no third face and no system display face.

rules.name: The Lowercase Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are lowercase branch names at 12px, weight 500, untracked. Nothing on the site is uppercase or letter-spaced outward.

rules.name: The Reserved Gutter Rule
rules.body: Log rows reserve 239px on the left for the lane field, and each lane is positioned under the horizontal center of its pill. Text never sits under a lane.

rules.name: The Designed Viewport Rule
rules.body: Between 1280 and 1600px the home page scales with the width (zoom clamped 0.93 to 1.16 around 1376px) rather than letting its fixed rhythm float in a wider frame.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Anything in document flow is flat. A shadow is permitted only on a fixed element floating over content, and it is the resume button's soft drop, never a hard offset.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: 4px focus ring, 5px inline code, 8px log rows, 10px panels, pill for tags and floating controls. No other radius.

rules.name: The Checkout Rule
rules.body: Hover or focus on a log row checks it out: the row bands, its node grows, and the preview swaps to it. Leaving returns to HEAD. New list surfaces reuse this rather than inventing a hover.

dos: Do declare every new color in both the `:root` block and the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block of assets/style.css; no hardcoded colors in rules.
Do give a branch-colored element `data-branch` and read `var(--c)`; never a branch hex.
Do put code in a `pre.code` panel with `data-lang`, add `diff` and `data-file` when they apply, and let site.js render the lines.
Do write post sections as h2 so the TOC and its scroll tracking build themselves.
Do keep hover and HEAD as a bg-band fill, and focus as the 2px backend-blue ring at a 3px offset.
Do keep any new motion to a 0.2 to 0.3s state transition on `--ease`; the log's rise is the only authored sequence, and it is off under reduced motion.
Do keep hashes, filenames, and the wordmark in Commit Mono with ligatures off.
donts: Don't add cards, gradients, thumbnails, or a shadow on anything in flow.
Don't add a third typeface, an icon font, or a glyph set; the only icon is one inline SVG chevron.
Don't uppercase or letter-space labels; branch names are lowercase 12px.
Don't add a branch without a color variable in both themes, a pill, and a lane; the graph reads the pills to place lanes.
Don't add per-page styles to posts; all CSS lives in assets/style.css.
Don't hand-write hashes; they come from the slug.
